explanation: Using v dv/dx=-6x, integration gives v²/2=-3x²+C. At x=2 and v=4, C=20. Thus rest requires x²=20/3, giving x=±(2/3)√15 m under the lesson's intended method (option e). Literally, magnitude 6x requires x≥0, so only the positive root is justified; no displayed choice gives exactly that value.
